utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I haven’t heard any updates yet, but I’ll keep an ear out while I’m out running errands.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Thanks, Ira. If you hear anything, just let me know and I’ll keep my plans flexible.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Of course — I’ll let you know if I hear anything.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sounds good — what do you need from me for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Just a quick headcount and what tools you can bring.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: I can bring a drill and a tape measure, and I’ll check on the headcount tonight.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: So this repair drive is definitely still happening, right? I just want to make sure before I tell anyone.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Yes, it’s still happening—but I’d double-check the time and drop-off details first, just to be safe.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Got it — I’ll double-check the time and drop-off details before I mention it to anyone.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, right — the repair drive! I’m happy to help, I just need to remember what we’re fixing first.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: We’re starting with the broken gate latch and the squeaky porch step—then we’ll see what else turns up.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh yes, the gate latch and porch step—I can handle those. Just point me to the tools, and I’ll try not to forget what I’m doing halfway through.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Could you remind me of the repair drive details first? I want to make sure I get everything right before I act.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Right, the repair drive — I’m a bit fuzzy on the details, but I think it’s for collecting stuff people need fixed. If you want, I can check and get back to you.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Yes, please check and get back to me with the exact details. I’d rather confirm before I do anything.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Sorry I’m late — I’m here for the repair drive. What do you need me to help with?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: No worries, Dane — glad you made it. If you can help sort tools and carry boxes, that’d be a huge help.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Absolutely — I can sort tools and carry boxes. Point me to where you want me to start.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: I’m happy to help with the repair drive — what do you need me to bring or do?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Thanks, Sam — could you bring your drill and a couple of screwdrivers? If you’ve got a free hour, helping me sort the donated tools would be a huge help.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Absolutely — I’ll bring my drill and a couple screwdrivers, and I can help sort the donated tools for an hour too.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I’m not sure yet—where should I go for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: The repair drive is at the community center by the school—if you head there after pickup, you should be all set.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Got it—I’ll head to the community center by the school after pickup. Thanks for pointing me there.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, I heard the repair drive is getting a pretty good turnout so far — folks have been dropping off tools and supplies all morning. I can swing by later and see what they still need.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: That’s wonderful — the more hands and supplies, the better. Swing by later, and I’ll make sure you get the latest list of what they still need.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Absolutely, I’ll stop by later and bring back the latest list. If they’re still short on anything, I’ll spread the word around the block.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Hey Rey, what kind of repairs are we collecting for on the drive?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Mostly small home fixes—leaky faucets, broken outlets, loose steps, that kind of thing. I can help you sort out the list if you want.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: That’d help, thanks. Should I start with the most urgent repairs first?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Sounds good — I’ll repeat the repair drive plans to everyone nearby and make sure folks know the details.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, Vik — I’m not always the first to hear things, so I appreciate you spreading the word.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Absolutely — I’ll keep repeating it around the block so nobody misses the repair drive details.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Sounds good, Uli — I’ll keep the repair drive organized and make sure everyone knows where to help. Let’s line up the tasks and get started.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Rosa. I’ll help where I can and keep it simple.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Perfect — I’ll sort the list and share the easiest jobs first. Thanks for pitching in, Uli.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, I heard the repair drive is getting a pretty good turnout already — folks are really pitching in. If you want, I can pass along the details I’ve heard.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: That’s good to hear. Please pass along the details, and I’ll plan to take a look.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Sure thing — it’s at the community hall this Saturday morning, and they’re asking for tools, batteries, and small appliance parts. I’ll let you know if I hear any updates.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Hey Vik, I’m a bit late—what’s the update on the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: No worries — the repair drive’s still on, and I’m repeating the plan to folks now: we’re collecting donations and sorting the tools. I’ll keep you posted if anything changes.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Got it — I’ll help sort the tools when I get there. Let me know if you need me to bring anything.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I can help, if you need a hand with the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Rey. I’d appreciate that—it's been a lot to handle lately.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Of course. Tell me what needs fixing first, and I’ll do what I can.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Yeah, I’m in—just send me the basics and I’ll take a look.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Great — I’ll send the basics and the location details, and I’ll keep it simple.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Perfect, thanks — keep it short and I’ll check it when you send it.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I’m happy to help with the repair drive—what do you need from me?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Jules — I’m checking the details first. Could you tell me what kinds of donations you can take and when you’re available?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I can help with tools, spare parts, and gently used household items. I’m free most evenings after 6 and Saturday morning too.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, right — the repair drive. I’m a bit behind, but I can help out if you need me.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Thanks, Noah — that would be a big help. I’ll send you the details so you can jump in where it’s easiest.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Sounds good — send them over, and I’ll take a look when I can.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Sounds good — I’ll keep an ear out while I’m out running errands.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Thanks, Ira — I appreciate that. If you hear anyone needing a hand, send them my way.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Will do, Gus — I’ll let folks know you’re available if I hear anything.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sure thing — what part of the repair drive do you want to tackle?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Let’s start with the broken curb ramp near Maple. I can bring tools and you can grab the cones.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sounds good — I’ll grab the cones and meet you by the curb ramp near Maple.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I’m happy to help, but I’d like to sort out the timing and drop-off details first.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Sure — what time works for you, and where should I drop it off?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I’m free after 4, and if you could drop it by my porch, that would be easiest.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Oh, I’m in—count me in for the repair drive! I’ll spread the word around the neighborhood too.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Thank you, Quinn — that would help a lot. I’ll keep track of what we still need and let you know.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Perfect, just send me the list and I’ll start asking folks right away. We’ll get this repair drive rolling.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I can help coordinate around the school schedule—what day is the repair drive, and what do you need from me?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, right — I’m still waiting on the exact day. If you can help once I confirm the school schedule, that’d be a huge help.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Absolutely — send me the day as soon as you have it, and I’ll work around the school schedule.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Absolutely — I’m keeping the repair drive organized and I’ll make sure everyone knows what’s needed. Let’s line up the tasks and I’ll get the list ready.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, Rosa — I’ll keep an ear out and pass along any updates I hear.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Perfect, Nell — I appreciate that. I’ll get the list sorted and share the next steps as soon as I have them.
